# AI with Robert — aiwithrobert.com
# Last updated: 2026-11-10

AI with Robert is the parent brand of Robert Simon, an independent AI educator and
consultant based in Côte Saint-Luc, Montréal, Quebec, Canada. Services are offered in
English and French. Phone: 514-250-8491. Email: info@aiwithrobert.com.

This page is a front door. It does not describe prices or services in detail; each
service has its own website.

## The two services (separate audiences)
- AI with Robert for Seniors — https://seniors.aiwithrobert.com (French: https://seniors.aiwithrobert.com/fr/)
  Patient, one-on-one AI and technology lessons for older adults and their families,
  in Côte Saint-Luc and Greater Montréal, at home or online.
- AI with Robert for Business — https://biz.aiwithrobert.com (French: https://biz.aiwithrobert.com/fr/)
  AI consulting, workflow automation and training for small businesses of about 5–20
  people in Greater Montréal.

## Related, separate site
- https://www.imetrobert.com — Robert Simon's personal professional profile and AI
  commentary. It is not a service website.

## Independence
AI with Robert is an independent practice of Robert Simon. Mentions of his professional
experience describe his background only; the business is not affiliated with, sponsored
by or endorsed by any employer, including Bell.

## Not to be confused with
Unrelated people or businesses using a similar name, including aiwithrobert.live.
